caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of furniture, specifically a chaise longue or daybed, centered within a plain rectangular frame. The structure of the daybed is rendered in a light brown color, resembling wood, with ornate, turned legs and crossbars connecting the legs for support. The seat and backrest are colored in a medium green shade, suggesting upholstered or cushioned sections. The backrest is reclined and supported by two posts that end in finials and are connected by a string or cord. The overall composition is minimalistic, with the object shown in profile view on a blank white background. The artist's signature, "B. Holst-Grubbe," is written in the bottom left corner inside the frame.
title: Day Bed
